node.label: Drew Gilpin Faust
node.date_label: A Sacred Circle (1977) · Mothers of Invention (1996) · This Republic of Suffering (2008)
node.description: Historian of the American South whose writing links slavery,women’s wartime choices and the cultural consequences of mass death. Faust’s interview with Jim Leach explains how slaveholders’ records can reveal enslaved family ties and how Confederate women’s exhaustion changed their relation to war. Her biographical work uses an individual life to investigate social structures while preserving the distinction between understanding and endorsement.
